---
name: Bug report
about: Report a crash or a wrong number in the sample builder, sweep, analysis or app
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

## What happened

A clear description of the wrong behavior (a crash, a number that does not match, a curve that looks wrong).

## Where

- [ ] `build_sample.py`
- [ ] `sweep.py`
- [ ] `analyze.py`
- [ ] `contamination_check.py`
- [ ] `server.py` or `index.html` (the two-seat app)

## How to reproduce

The exact command, the model name, and the smallest input that still shows it. Paste the `analyze.py` header line (model, records, unparsed) if the issue is about results.

## Environment

Python version, Ollama version, model, and operating system.
